links.outcome: Longitudinal model performance stability and drift over the study period
links.effect: Longitudinal evaluation showed stable performance with no model drift (retrospective analysis of records from May 2022 to March 2025, not a live deployment).
links.quote: Longitudinal evaluation revealed stable performance without model drift.

unlisted_practices: Unsupervised anomaly detection (Isolation Forest, LOF) for near-real-time alerting of radiotherapy setup errors
Closed-loop setup-monitoring-alert framework as an auxiliary quality-assurance tool

screen.reason: The study develops and retrospectively evaluates an unsupervised anomaly detection model (Isolation Forest / LOF) for radiotherapy setup error quality control alerting, but does not test a specific deployment practice or guardrail intervention.
